title: rosa obtusifolia f. eminens
intro: Rosa obtusifolia f. eminens, commonly known as the Fragrant Mountain Rose, is a plant species of the Rosa genus that is native to the mountainous regions of China. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The therapeutic actions of Rosa obtusifolia f. eminens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat a range of health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections.
